page_title: inlaut – Deine Stimme. Direkt als Text.

sources.entry: inlaut - Fully local push-to-talk dictation for German and English, running a Parakeet model on-device and typing at the cursor. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tobymarks/inlaut) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: inlaut
summary.one_liner: Free, open-source, local push-to-talk dictation app for macOS and Windows (beta) that types German or English speech as text at the cursor.
use_cases: Dictating emails and messages into any text field
Writing notes or documents by voice without cloud services
Transcribing a recorded meeting or voice message on a Mac
Dictating German and English text hands-free
summary.what_it_does: inlaut records speech while a push-to-talk key is held (or in a hands-free mode on Mac) and inserts the recognized text at the cursor in the active app. Speech recognition runs on the local computer, and normal dictation is stated not to be saved or transmitted. On Mac it uses the Parakeet model for German and English, including mixed speech, with an option to use Apple's local recognition for a chosen language. Cleanup options can remove filler words and duplicated words, and spoken commands like "neue Zeile" and "neuer Absatz" insert line and paragraph breaks. Custom replacements fix recurring errors, and the Mac version can transcribe audio or video files locally.
notable: Speech recognition runs fully on-device with no account and no cloud
Open source under GPL-3.0 on GitHub
Spoken line and paragraph commands plus custom text replacements and text snippets
Mac version can transcribe audio or video files locally
caveats: Windows version is an unsigned beta; Windows may show a security warning, and text insertion may not work in every app
Windows beta lacks file transcription, mixed-language dictation, and the cleanup/self-correction features
Mac requires Apple Silicon with macOS 26 or newer; no Linux, iPhone, iPad or Windows ARM version
Mac setup downloads a roughly 630 MB speech model on first launch
